title: Code of Criminal Procedure Sindh Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Sindh Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT VI OF 2018
ACT VI OF 2018
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT,
2017
An Act to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 in its application
to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 26th February, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-33/2017,
dated 26.2.2018.---The Code of
Criminal Procedure (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th January, 2018 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 20th February, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1898, in its application to the Province of Sindh, in the
manner hereinafter appearing;
It
Is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Code of Criminal Procedure (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

sections.description:
Insertion of sections 156-C and 156-D in Act No. V of 1898

ACT VI OF 2018
ACT VI OF 2018
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT,
2017
An Act to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 in its application
to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 26th February, 2018]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-33/2017,
dated 26.2.2018.---The Code of
Criminal Procedure (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th January, 2018 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 20th February, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1898, in its application to the Province of Sindh, in the
manner hereinafter appearing;
It
Is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 144 of Act No. V of 1898.---In the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, in its application to the
Province of Sindh, in section 144 -
(a) in
subsection (1), for the words "Zila Nazim", the words
"Provincial Government or its authorized officer" and for the words
"District Superintendent of Police or Executive District Officer, the
words "Deputy Commissioner or District Superintendent of Police"
shall respectively be substituted;
(b) in
subsection (4), for the words "Zila Nazim" may, either on his own
motion", the words "Provincial Government or its authorized officer
may, on its or his own motion" shall be substituted;
(c) in
subsection (5), for the words "Zila Nazim", the words "Provincial
Government or its authorized officer and for the word 'he shall record in
writing his reasons", the words "it or he shall record in writing the
reasons" shall respectively be substituted;
(d) in
subsection (6), for the words "the Provincial Government", the words
"the Provincial Government or its authorized officer" shall be
substituted: and
(e) subsection
(7) shall be omitted.
